nodes.description: Public token symbol state variable initialized to "WC".
Public token name state variable initialized to "WenCoinbase".
Public token decimals state variable set to 18.
Private total supply of 1e27 tokens; mutated by burning in transfer/transferFrom.
Constant-like state variable (100) used as rounding modulus in findOnePercent.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping holder => spender => amount; written in approve and transferFrom.
Library function adding two uint256 with a >= check.
Library function subtracting two uint256 with a b <= a check.
Library function multiplying two uint256 with an assertion on the result.
Library function dividing two uint256 without a zero check.
Library function rounding a value up to a multiple of m.
Constructor that mints the entire _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits a Transfer event.
View function returning the private _totalSupply.
View function returning balances[holder].
View function returning allowed[holder][spender].
Private view function computing the burn amount using ceil/mul/div with oneHundredPercent.
Transfers amount to a recipient, burning a computed fee and reducing _totalSupply.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to amount and emits Approval.
Spends allowance to transfer tokens, burning a fee and decreasing allowance and _totalSupply.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, debiting balances and writing allowances.
balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(amount) arithmetic state update in transfer.
_totalSupply = _totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn) arithmetic burn in transfer.
Fee computation roundAmount.mul(oneHundredPercent).div(1000) inside findOnePercent.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(amount) arithmetic allowance update.
balances[from] = balances[from].sub(amount) arithmetic balance debit in transferFrom.
Address parameter holder of balanceOf.
Address parameter spender of allowance.
Recipient address parameter to of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer, used for balance checks and fee computation.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Source address parameter from of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter to of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, checked against balance and allowance.
Amount parameter of findOnePercent.
Local fee amount returned by findOnePercent in transfer.
Local net transfer amount amount.sub(tokensToBurn) in transfer.
Local fee amount returned by findOnePercent in transferFrom.
Local net transfer amount amount.sub(tokensToBurn) in transferFrom.
Local rounded amount produced by amount.ceil(oneHundredPercent) in findOnePercent.
Local burn result roundAmount.mul(oneHundredPercent).div(1000) in findOnePercent.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the whole supply to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
Constructor mints _totalSupply to msg.sender.
totalSupply returns the state variable _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances[holder].
allowance reads allowed[holder][spender].
findOnePercent reads oneHundredPercent for rounding and fee math.
findOnePercent calls SafeMath.ceil on the input amount.
SafeMath.ceil uses SafeMath.add(a,m).
SafeMath.ceil uses SafeMath.sub(c,1).
SafeMath.ceil uses SafeMath.mul(div(d,m),m).
SafeMath.ceil uses SafeMath.div(d,m).
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls the source balance.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer burns tokens by decreasing _totalSupply.
transfer calls findOnePercent to compute the burn fee.
transfer executes balances[msg.sender].sub(amount).
transfer executes _totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn).
transfer relies on SafeMath.sub for user-supplied amounts.
Result of the subtraction is written back into balances[msg.sender].
Balance subtraction is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
Result of the burn subtraction is written back into _totalSupply.
Supply burn subtraction is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender], making the caller the spender.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom burns tokens from _totalSupply.
transferFrom calls findOnePercent to compute the burn fee.
transferFrom executes allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(amount).
transferFrom executes balances[from].sub(amount).
Reduced allowance is written back into the allowed mapping.
Reduced balance is written back into the balances mapping.
Balance debit in transferFrom is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
Allowance debit in transferFrom is delegated to SafeMath.sub.
findOnePercent performs the mul/div fee arithmetic on user-controlled amount.
Fee computation uses SafeMath.mul.
Fee computation uses SafeMath.div, which has no zero-divisor guard.
balanceOf consumes the holder parameter.
allowance consumes the spender parameter.
transfer consumes the to parameter.
transfer consumes the amount parameter.
approve consumes the spender parameter.
approve consumes the amount parameter.
transferFrom consumes the from parameter.
transferFrom consumes the to parameter.
transferFrom consumes the amount parameter.
findOnePercent consumes the amount parameter.
transfer holds the tokensToBurn local fee value.
transfer holds the tokensToTransfer local net value.
transferFrom holds the tokensToBurn local fee value.
transferFrom holds the tokensToTransfer local net value.
findOnePercent holds the roundAmount local value.
findOnePercent holds the fivePercent local return value.
User-supplied transfer amount flows into the balance subtraction.
User-supplied transferFrom amount flows into the allowance subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: The holder parameter is only meaningful as the lookup key of balanceOf and has no independent lifetime.
The spender parameter is only used to index allowed inside the allowance view function.
The to parameter is entirely scoped to the transfer function and should be folded into it.
The amount parameter only exists as transfer input and feeds directly into its arithmetic.
The spender parameter is used only to write allowed[msg.sender][spender] inside approve.
The amount parameter is used only as the allowance value written by approve.
The from parameter is only the debit source address inside transferFrom.
The to parameter is only the credit destination address inside transferFrom.
The amount parameter is consumed only by transferFrom checks and subtractions.
The amount parameter is only used by findOnePercent to derive the burn fee.
The local burn value exists solely to feed the _totalSupply subtraction in transfer.
The net transfer local is an intermediate value fully contained in transfer.
The local burn value exists solely to feed the balance/supply debits in transferFrom.
The net transfer local is an intermediate value fully contained in transferFrom.
roundAmount exists only as the intermediate of the fee arithmetic inside findOnePercent.
fivePercent is the returned local of findOnePercent and has no independent role.
